description: Solana native only: build a fresh unsigned SOL transfer with a confirmed blockhash. Call only after the user confirms, then dex_wallet_sign_transaction and dex_tx_send_raw_transaction in the same turn. Do not reuse dex_tx_transfer_preview output.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

priority_fee_micro_lamports.description: Optional priority fee (micro-lamports per compute unit). Try 1000-10000 if broadcast returns replacement transaction underpriced.

name: dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned
